name: VNWoodKnot
description: An image dataset and benchmark for detecting and classifying wood knots in timber images to support automated quality assessment.
evaluation_method: mAP (mean Average Precision) for detection; accuracy / F1 for classification
reputation: Domain-specific dataset for timber-quality assessment with limited adoption outside wood-processing and materials-science communities.
notes: Domain-specific, non-LLM computer-vision benchmark; likely class imbalance and limited dataset scale; potential dataset bias from imaging conditions (lighting, wood species); limited community reuse outside industry/research groups focused on timber quality.
